name: Acid Arrow
description: On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow deals half the initial damage and no later damage (half on a miss is not expressible). At Higher Levels: both increase by 1d4 per slot level above 2nd (only the first effect scales).

m.text: powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach
